title.value: Write a parking ticket appeal that got dismissed

introduction.value: The poster used ChatGPT to draft an appeal of a street-sweeping parking ticket, and the ticket was dismissed.

method.value: The poster fed ChatGPT-4 the specifics of a $75 street-sweeping ticket, the city sewage project that had pushed parking more than a mile away, and the fact they were sick and forgot to move the car. ChatGPT drafted a polite but firm email to the city council; the poster edited hallucinated details, sent it themself, and then heard back from the city manager and maintenance head.

outcome.value: The city manager replied the next day, and the head of maintenance said the ticket was dismissed with no further action required. In comments, the poster and others said ChatGPT mainly improved the writing rather than creating the underlying argument.

notes.value: The main catch was manual editing: the poster says ChatGPT hallucinated some details, so they tweaked the draft before sending it.

Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Help me appeal a parking ticket. Details: [ticket number, date, location, violation, city]. My situation: [why it was unfair, such as unclear signs, wrong time, or an emergency]. Look up the city's appeal rules and deadline, then draft a short, polite appeal letter with a list of evidence I should attach. Show me the draft before I submit anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/144mzb5
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: A driver used ChatGPT to improve a challenge to a parking penalty.
introduction.zh: 一位驾驶者用 ChatGPT 改善停车罚单申诉表达。

method.en: The driver described a $75 street-sweeping penalty, a city sewage project that pushed available parking more than a mile away, illness and forgetting to move the vehicle.
method.zh: 驾驶者提供75美元清扫街道罚单、市政排污工程导致停车点远至一英里外，以及生病忘记移车的背景。

method.en: ChatGPT-4 drafted a polite, firm message to the city council. The person removed invented details and sent the email themselves.
method.zh: ChatGPT-4起草语气礼貌但坚定的市议会邮件；本人删除虚构细节并自行发送。

outcome.en: The city manager reportedly replied the next day; the maintenance head then said the ticket was dismissed with nothing further required.
outcome.zh: 据述市经理次日回复，随后维护负责人表示罚单撤销，无需进一步处理。

notes.en: The poster and commenters characterized the benefit mainly as better writing, not a new argument. Actual ChatGPT differs from the suggested ChatGPT Agent template.
notes.zh: 发帖者及评论者认为主要收益在表达改善，而非创造新论据；实际ChatGPT不同于推荐模板的ChatGPT Agent。
